subject: Commit clearinghouse & leadership pack routing
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: commit clearinghouse & leadership pack routing

Team —

Quick kickoff to route the January commit cleanup and leadership pack intake. Goal: get a single canonical commit list for QBR packs and flag anything we won’t take as a commit for the quarter by EOD Jan 19. Concrete asks: 

- Markus: own the commit de-dupe and stage normalization (STG/CC/COMMIT).
- Lauren: own the leadership pack slice (pull top 12 by ARR and any at-risk commits).
- Grace: run the QA pass on the final CSV and sanity-check ARR math.
- Karthik: I’ll loop you in for any pricing/credit language we need to call out to leadership.

Attached: QBR_Pack_Template_v3.pptx — please use slide 2 template for commit excerpts. I also attached a starter CSV (ACME_commit_list.csv) from the AMs to illustrate format.

Process notes: we’ll consolidate CSVs into a single sheet in the shared Drive (link below). I’ll assemble the leadership bundle and share a dry-run by Jan 20 for exec review.

If anything blocks ownership (overlapping deals, large credits, or legal review), flag it inline in the CSV and @ the person.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attach: QBR_Pack_Template_v3.pptx (pptx)
attach: ACME_commit_list.csv (csv)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: commit clearinghouse & leadership pack routing

Thanks — will take the de-dupe. Quick clarifying Qs: 

- Do we treat channel-sourced ARR the same as direct for commit math? (I think yes, but want to be explicit).
- Any deals we should pre-flag for a possible credit/exception that would remove them from the commit? (List them in the CSV under "exceptions" column).

Plan: I’ll run a merge -> normalize stages -> flag duplicates by close date and account. Expect an interim CSV back by EOD Jan 14.

-Markus

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: commit clearinghouse & leadership pack routing

Sounds good. I can curate the top-of-pack list and schedule a 30-min dry-run review with leadership the week of Jan 24. Requests from my side: 

- Please ensure each row has a single owner and estimated probability. I’ll treat anything under 40% as "not ready for commit."
- If anyone expects legal/procurement delays that change close timing, add an ETA in the notes column.

I’ll start a calendar invite for Jan 25 9:30am PT and invite the usual exec reviewers; will share a deck draft 48 hours before.

Lauren

Cc: ops+acme@acme.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commit clearinghouse & leadership pack routing

Mina / Lauren —

Thanks for the note. Attaching our updated commit CSV from the account team (includes revised close dates and PO timing). Our procurement lead has asked that anything requiring a credit approval be raised by Jan 18 so they can align legal timelines.

A couple of specifics on our side: 
- Large renewal (ACME-2027-R1) will require a SOC-2 addendum review — that may push final signature into Feb depending on legal cycles.
- We expect PO issuance by Jan 28 if there are no pricing exceptions.

Attached: ACME_commit_list.csv (updated).

—Sarah
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Final: routing plan + deadlines (leadership bundle)

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. Short summary and next steps (please action):

1) Markus — resolve duplicates and normalize stages; add a column "leadership_flag" for top-12 accounts with ARR > $250k. Deliverable: normalized CSV v1 by COB Jan 14 (please attach to this thread).

2) Lauren — pull slides for top-12 and any at-risk callouts. I’ll slot the dry-run Jan 25 9:30am PT; calendar invite forthcoming.

3) Grace — QA math and confirm ARR totals; call out any suspicious discounts in the "exceptions" tab.

4) Karthik — ready to confirm any credit language; I’ll loop you when Markus flags exceptions.

Deadline: final leadership bundle (single PPT + canonical CSV) in Drive by Jan 20 09:00 PT. I will do a pass and send to execs for a Jan 21 morning readout.

If you need to escalate a tricky deal to sales leadership earlier, tag me and I’ll route to the CRO for an exception review.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachments: QBR_Pack_Template_v3.pptx; ACME_commit_list.csv
